```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(doParallel)
library(broom)
library(kableExtra)
library(car)
```

The purpose of this document is to test if the first subjects we gathered are actually good. That is, we may have limited the amount of risk per trials without enough evidence that it was not working within a mixed effect framework that controls for the amount of yes and no (the YN_diif regressor). 

Note you would still need to go test if risks and gains are different from one another. 
Todo: go get the subject estimates and see if linear main effects only, that risks or gains are larger.

```{r}
batch_1 <- read_csv(here("data", "Cleaned_Pilot", "batch.1.csv"))
```
 
```{r}
batch_1 <- filter(batch_1, rt <= 90000 & rt >= 250)
batch_1 <- subset(batch_1, with(batch_1, user_id %in% names(which(table(user_id)>=40))))
#How many observations does each subject have in each class (yes and no)?
datalist = list()
for (i in batch_1$user_id){
  x = filter(batch_1, user_id == i)
  dat = table(x$experimental_treatment_selected) #Check Class bias
  datalist[[i]] = dat # add it to your list
}
Observation_Counts = do.call(rbind, datalist)
colnames(Observation_Counts) = c('No', 'Yes')
#summary(Observation_Counts)
rm(i, x,datalist, dat)

x <- distinct(batch_1, user_id)

Observation_Counts <- cbind(Observation_Counts, x)
batch_1 <-  merge(batch_1, Observation_Counts, "user_id")

batch_1$experimental_treatment_selected = as.factor(batch_1$experimental_treatment_selected)

batch_1 %>% 
  select(user_id, condition, risk, gain, experimental_treatment_selected,Yes, No) %>% 
  mutate(experimental_treatment_selected = ifelse(experimental_treatment_selected == "Yes to treatment", 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(YN_diff = Yes - No) -> test
```
 
```{r}
continuous <- c("risk", "gain", "YN_diff")
test$user_id <- factor(test$user_id)

test[,continuous] <- scale(test[,continuous])  
#model 1 only linear terms
#cl <- makePSOCKcluster() #use parallel processing

registerDoParallel()
#start with risk, and gain
m.1 <- glmer(experimental_treatment_selected ~ YN_diff + risk + gain  +
               (risk + gain + I(gain^2) + I(risk^2)| user_id), 
             data = test, family = binomial(link="logit"), 
             control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"),
             nAGQ = 0)

#add poly gain
m.2 <- glmer(experimental_treatment_selected ~ YN_diff + risk + gain + I(gain^2) +
               (risk + gain + I(gain^2) + I(risk^2)| user_id), 
             data = test, family = binomial(link="logit"), 
             control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"),
             nAGQ = 0)
#just add poly risk 
m.3 <- glmer(experimental_treatment_selected ~ YN_diff + risk + gain + I(gain^2) + I(risk^2) + 
               (risk + gain + I(gain^2) + I(risk^2)| user_id), 
             data = test, family = binomial(link="logit"), 
             control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"),
             nAGQ = 0)
#linear interaction
m.4 <-  glmer(experimental_treatment_selected ~ YN_diff + 
                risk + gain + 
                I(gain^2) + I(risk^2) + 
                risk:gain + 
                (risk + gain + I(gain^2) + I(risk^2)| user_id), 
              data = test, family = binomial(link="logit"), 
              control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"),
              nAGQ = 0)
#next interaction
m.5 <-  glmer(experimental_treatment_selected ~ YN_diff + 
                risk + gain +
                I(risk^2) + I(gain^2)+
                risk:gain+
                risk:I(gain^2) +
                (risk + gain + I(gain^2) + I(risk^2)| user_id), 
              data = test, family = binomial(link="logit"), 
              control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"),
              nAGQ = 0)

m.6 <-  glmer(experimental_treatment_selected ~ YN_diff + 
                risk + gain +
                I(risk^2) + I(gain^2)+
                risk:gain+
                risk:I(gain^2) +
                gain:I(risk^2) + 
                (risk + gain + I(gain^2) + I(risk^2)| user_id), 
              data = test, family = binomial(link="logit"), 
              control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"),
              nAGQ = 0)

m.7 <-  glmer(experimental_treatment_selected ~ YN_diff + 
                risk + gain +
                I(risk^2) + I(gain^2)+
                risk:gain+
                risk:I(gain^2) +
                gain:I(risk^2) + 
                I(risk^2):I(gain^2)+
                (risk + gain + I(gain^2) + I(risk^2)| user_id), 
              data = test, family = binomial(link="logit"), 
              control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"),
              nAGQ = 0)

m.8 <-  glmer(experimental_treatment_selected ~ YN_diff + 
                risk + gain +
                + I(gain^2)+
                risk:I(gain^2) +
                (risk + gain + I(gain^2) + I(risk^2)| user_id), 
              data = test, family = binomial(link="logit"), 
              control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"),
              nAGQ = 0)

table <-anova(m.1, m.2, m.3, m.4, m.5, m.6, m.7, type = "LRT")
tab <- map_df(list(table), tidy)
options(knitr.kable.NA = '')
knitr::kable(tab[c("term", "npar", "AIC", "BIC", "logLik", "deviance", "statistic", 
                   "df", "p.value")], caption = "Model Comparison")%>%  
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position")
#######
Anova(m.5, type = "III")
ggeffects::ggpredict(m.5, terms=c("risk", "gain"))

stopImplicitCluster()
```

```{r}
plot(ggeffects::ggpredict(m.3, terms=c("risk [all]", "gain")))+ 
  geom_hline(yintercept = .50)
plot(ggeffects::ggpredict(m.3, terms=c("gain [all]", "risk")))+ 
  geom_hline(yintercept = .50)

parameters::model_parameters(m.3) %>% 
  filter(!Parameter == "(Intercept)")->x
kable(x[c("Parameter", "Coefficient", "SE", "CI_low", "CI_high", "z", "p")])%>%  
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position")

ggplot(data=x,
    aes(Parameter, Coefficient, ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high ))+
    geom_pointrange()+
    geom_hline(aes(fill=Parameter),yintercept =0, linetype=2)+
    xlab('parameter')+ ylab("(95% Confidence Interval)")+
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=CI_low, ymax = CI_high),width=0.5,cex=1)+ 
    theme(plot.title=element_text(size=16,face="bold"),
        axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_text(face="bold"),
        axis.title=element_text(size=12,face="bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(hjust=0,vjust = 1,angle=180,face=  "bold"))+
    coord_flip() + 
    theme(legend.position="none")+theme_bw()

ggstatsplot::ggcoefstats(m.3,
point.args = list(color = "red", size = 3, shape = 15),
  vline.args = list(size = 1, color = "#CC79A7", linetype = "dotdash"),
  title = "Logistic mixed model predicting experimental treatment selected",
  ggstatsplot.layer = FALSE
) 
```
